capabilities: track papers through reading statuses (To read, Reading, Read, Reviewed)
categorize papers and rate importance with stars and tags
create a note per paper with a reference block and comment
import paper metadata from Zotero via the Zotero Bridge plugin
search and filter papers in a side panel
extras: Manual installation instructions are included; import from Zotero requires the Zotero Bridge plugin and Zotero running; paper list is stored in the plugin's data.json alongside per-paper notes; note content preservation behavior on edits is documented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage an academic reading list with per-paper status, categorization and structured paper notes.

relations.evidence: Install and enable the Zotero Bridge community plugin and keep Zotero running.

summary: Literature tracker that records papers with reading status, categories and metadata, creates one note per paper, and imports from Zotero.
